content: Kakuni

Wetsareri kakuni kaniutawewieni 'akatsiya kɨyeyarikɨ, xeimeturuyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tewime, haika tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume meta yaxeikɨata mɨpaɨ heutitewame.
Huru taɨtana kanewakuwirieni meta herie, meta hurukɨ kanetatenitɨani.
Naukame huru hanirayari kaniutiwewieni kakunitsie mieme, 'ɨkateyatsie ne'uitɨani, tapa 'etsatana hutatɨ na'uni tapata hutatɨ.
Meta kurumawime 'akatsiya kɨyeyari kaniutiwewieni, huru kanitiwirieni,
haniratsie kaneiye'uitɨaxɨani kakuni 'etsata mukumanetsie, mukukweiyanenikɨ.
Hurukɨ xeikɨa kanamikiyari kaniutawewieni Kakaɨyari ma'axe, xeimeturuyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tewime meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume.
Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama pɨwarutiwewi hurukɨ, titsunamekɨ mewewiyatɨkaime, kanamiki Kakaɨyari ma'axe 'etsimeuyeyeutsie mema'unikɨ yuxexuitɨ.
Xewitɨ 'etsimeuyewatsie kanakeni, xewitɨta tapa, Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama memɨyuhuta, meyuxewiriyame kaniwarayeitɨani Kakaɨyari ma'axeni mame.
Kakaɨyari teɨtamete Kakaɨyari ma'axe heima mepuye'anatɨkatei, kɨmana mepenukanakai. Mepanuyutaxeiyakai Kakaɨyari ma'axe meheukanenieretɨ.
'Akatsiya mexayari

Wetsareri mexa kaniutawewieni 'akatsiya kɨyeyarikɨ, nauka tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tewime meta huta tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume, meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'aweme.
Huru kanikawirieni, hurukɨtsiere kaneta'utɨani.
Metatsiere xeitewiyari tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume kanatawewieni tenimeyari, mɨkɨta hurukɨ kaneta'utɨani.
Naukame huru hanirayari kaniutiwewieni 'ɨkateyatsie kane'uitɨaxɨani, 'etsatana huhutatatɨ kana'uixɨani 'ɨkateya ma'utɨkatsie.
Hanira, mexa tenimeyari hetɨa neimana, mana kɨyexi muye'unikɨ mukukweiyanenikɨ.
Mɨkɨ 'akatsiya kɨyexiyari pɨhɨkɨtɨkai huru wiriyarietɨkaitɨ.
Naime hurukɨ xeikɨa pɨtiutiwewi tita mana mɨrapinirekekai xakɨrɨte, 'itɨte, tekɨxite, ye'ɨrɨte 'amɨnene winu memutimawakai hetana.
Kɨxeme 'uitɨwame
Wetsareri kɨxeme 'uitɨwame kaniutawewieni hurukɨ xeikɨa, titsunamekɨ wewiyakame. Hetsiena maweni meta 'ɨkayari, muwatixaxawa, tekɨxiyari meta tuturiyari naitɨ puyuxewiriyakai.
Kɨxeme 'ataxewime yumamate pexeiyakai, tapa haikatɨ tapata haikatɨ.
Xexuime mamateyaritsie haikakɨa hewatixaxawame 'arimetɨra tuturiyari hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyatɨkaime, tuturi yu'iwitsi hexeiyakame meta xawariyari.
Kɨxeme 'uitɨwame peixeiyakaita naukame tekɨxiyari 'arimetɨra tuturiyari hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyame, yu'iwitsi meta yuxawari hexeiyame.

Mexɨakame mamateya paritsiyari hetɨatsie peixeiyakai xeime yutekɨxi, hutarieka paritsiyari hetɨatsie peixeiyakai hutarieka tekɨxi, meta hairieka paritsiyari hetɨatsie peixeiyakai hairieka mieme tekɨxi.
Tekɨxite meta mamateyari puyuxewiriyakai kɨxeme 'uitɨwame matɨa, hurukɨ xeikɨa titsunamekɨ wewiyakame.
'Atahuta kɨxeme hurukɨ xeikɨa kaniutiwewieni, meta kɨmana mɨtaire meta naxiyari makawiwieni.
Mɨkɨ kɨxeme 'uitɨwame mɨtawewierekɨ meta tinaitɨ mɨreukapine xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana haika kiruyari huru kaniuyɨni.
'Ɨkwa witsimu'ɨa mexayari

Wetsareri 'ɨkwa witsimu'ɨa taiyame mexayari kaniutawewieni 'akatsiya kɨyeyarikɨ. Yaxeikɨa huta tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsenitimeturuyari tewime meta huta tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeume, meta nauka tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'aweme. 'Awateya naitɨ kaniyuxewiriyakaitɨni mɨkɨ mexa matɨa.
Herie kanikawirieni huru metatsiere naitsarie 'etsatana meta 'awateyatsie, hurukɨ xeikɨa tenimeyaritsie kanetawirieni.
Tenimeyari manukaniere hanira kanamanaxɨani mana kɨyexi meuye'unikɨ mukukweiyanenikɨ.
Kɨyexi 'akatsiya kɨyeyari kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, huru wiriyarietɨkaitɨ.
Wetsareri hatseiti mɨpatsie kaniukawewieni meta 'ɨkwa witsimu'ɨa, witsimɨtiu'ɨatɨka wewiwamete wahepaɨ katiniwewieni.
